seo_get_entry_meta.description: Resolves one entry's effective SEO meta (title, description, canonical, robots, OpenGraph, Twitter card, JSON-LD), applying the override > site-default > derived precedence. Read-only.

entryId.description: The entry's id (a post or page), as returned by other tools that list or return entries.

search.keywords: seo meta title description tags page preview snippet
queries: What SEO title and description is actually showing for this page?
Can you show me the effective meta tags for this entry?
What's the resolved Open Graph and Twitter card data for this page?
I want to see the final SEO values after overrides are applied.
What does the JSON-LD look like for this specific entry?

seo_analyze_entry.description: Runs the SEO analysis (score 0-100 plus a list of issues, e.g. missing title/description) over one entry's effective SEO meta. Read-only.

entryId.description: The entry's id (a post or page), as returned by other tools that list or return entries.

search.keywords: seo search results ranking google visibility not showing up indexed problems audit page
queries: How's this page's SEO score?
What SEO issues does this page have, like a missing description?
Can you audit this entry's search-engine metadata?
Is this page missing anything important for SEO?
Can you grade this page's SEO out of 100?

seo_set_entry_overrides.description: Sets one or more per-entry SEO field overrides, merged onto the entry's existing overrides (omitted fields are left unchanged; an unregistered field name is rejected). Pass null for a field to clear that override back to inheriting the site default / derived value. If the patch touches 'noindex' or 'canonical', the sitemap cache is invalidated so the next sitemap read reflects the change. Pass expectedVersion from content_read.seo_entry_meta; if someone changed it since, nothing is saved and you must re-read.

entryId.description: The entry's id (a post or page), as returned by other tools that list or return entries.

expectedVersion.description: The record's version from content_read.seo_entry_meta. Required.

title.description: Meta title override. Optional override. At most 500 characters. Omit to leave the existing override (if any) unchanged. Pass null to clear this override.

description.description: Meta description override. Optional override. At most 500 characters. Omit to leave the existing override (if any) unchanged. Pass null to clear this override.

canonical.description: Canonical URL override (absolute). Optional override. At most 2048 characters. Omit to leave the existing override (if any) unchanged. Pass null to clear this override.

noindex.description: Set true to exclude this entry from indexing (emits robots:noindex and drops it from the sitemap). Pass null to clear this override and inherit the site default.

nofollow.description: Set true to emit robots:nofollow for this entry. Pass null to clear this override and inherit the site default.

schemaType.description: JSON-LD schema.org @type override. Optional override. At most 500 characters. Omit to leave the existing override (if any) unchanged. Pass null to clear this override.

ogTitle.description: OpenGraph title override. Optional override. At most 500 characters. Omit to leave the existing override (if any) unchanged. Pass null to clear this override.

ogDescription.description: OpenGraph description override. Optional override. At most 500 characters. Omit to leave the existing override (if any) unchanged. Pass null to clear this override.

ogImage.description: OpenGraph image override (media ref or absolute URL). Optional override. At most 2048 characters. Omit to leave the existing override (if any) unchanged. Pass null to clear this override.

ogType.description: OpenGraph type override. One of website, article, profile. Pass null to clear this override.

twitterTitle.description: Twitter/X card title override. Optional override. At most 500 characters. Omit to leave the existing override (if any) unchanged. Pass null to clear this override.

twitterDescription.description: Twitter/X card description override. Optional override. At most 500 characters. Omit to leave the existing override (if any) unchanged. Pass null to clear this override.

twitterImage.description: Twitter/X card image override (media ref or absolute URL). Optional override. At most 2048 characters. Omit to leave the existing override (if any) unchanged. Pass null to clear this override.

twitterCard.description: Twitter/X card kind override. One of summary, summary_large_image. Pass null to clear this override.

search.keywords: seo meta title description override page tags hide google noindex robots search engines index indexing exclude
queries: Can you set a custom SEO title for just this one page?
I want to override the meta description on this entry.
How do I mark this page as noindex?
Can you set a canonical URL for this entry — does that also refresh the sitemap?
How do I override SEO fields for one page without touching the site defaults?

seo_get_settings.description: Reads the workspace's site-wide SEO settings (title template, default description/OG image/Twitter site, default robots directive, sitemap toggle, custom robots.txt rules). Read-only.

search.keywords: seo settings current site wide defaults meta social
queries: What are our site-wide SEO defaults?
What's our default Open Graph image set to?
Is the sitemap toggle turned on for the whole site?
What do our robots.txt custom rules look like?
What's the title template applied across all pages?

seo_set_settings.description: Updates one or more of the workspace's site-wide SEO settings. All-or-nothing: if any field in the patch fails validation, nothing is written. Omitted fields are left unchanged.

titleTemplate.description: Title template applied to every entry without its own title override. MUST contain '%s' at least once (the per-page title is substituted there). At most 500 characters.

defaultDescription.description: Site-wide default meta description, used when an entry has neither its own override nor a derivable excerpt. At most 500 characters. Pass null to clear.

defaultOgImage.description: Site-wide default OpenGraph/Twitter image (media ref or absolute URL). At most 2048 characters. Pass null to clear.

twitterSite.description: Site-wide @handle attributed as the Twitter/X card's site. At most 100 characters. Pass null to clear.

defaultRobots.description: Site-wide default robots directive, used when an entry has no per-entry noindex/nofollow override.

sitemapEnabled.description: Whether the sitemap is advertised in robots.txt at all.

robotsRules.description: Custom robots.txt rules, one per user agent. At most 50 rules.

userAgent.description: The user agent this rule targets, e.g. '*' or 'Googlebot'.

allow.description: Allowed path prefixes. At most 100 entries.

disallow.description: Disallowed path prefixes. At most 100 entries.

search.keywords: seo settings change update site wide defaults meta social robots
queries: Can you update our default meta description for the whole site?
How do I change the site-wide title template?
Can you turn off the sitemap for the whole site?
I want to update our robots.txt rules — will it fail entirely if one field is wrong?
How do I set a new default social share image sitewide?

seo_regenerate_sitemap.description: Force-rebuilds the workspace's cached sitemap now, bypassing the cache-hit path. Never loses data — it only recomputes the same entries a normal cache-miss read would compute, sooner.

search.keywords: sitemap google search engine index rebuild regenerate crawl submit
queries: Can you force the sitemap to rebuild right now?
Our sitemap seems stale, can you refresh it?
How do I bypass the sitemap cache and regenerate it immediately?
Can you rebuild the sitemap without losing any entries?
I just changed a bunch of pages, can you regenerate the sitemap now?
